step: ADR-015 remediation step 6 — R-11 (MEDIUM-3): symmetric revocation, role-edit removal check, last-organization-administrator protection (migration 0028), R-6 revoke side
usage: source the DATABASE_* environment of a test template database at migration 0024 or later, then: node scripts/mutation/run.mjs scripts/mutation/catalogue/step6-r11.json --out <dir>. Every command first applies the (mutated) migrations to its disposable clone. `killedBy` is informational: the test expected to fail (checked in the logs).
